description: This file contains ONNX symbolic definitions and export logic for PyTorch's opset 10 within the Torch ONNX exporter. It includes implementations for various operator conversions, support for quantized models, and utility functions specific to opset 10.

methods.name: div(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other, *args)
methods.description: Defines the symbolic for the division operation, supports true division and rounding modes.

methods.name: _div_rounding_mode(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other, rounding_mode)
methods.description: Implements division with specified rounding mode, supporting floor mode for integer division.

methods.name: _floor_divide(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, other)
methods.description: Implements floor division, handling floating point and integer cases separately.

methods.name: topk(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, k, dim, largest, sorted, out=None)
methods.description: Defines symbolic for top-k operation with args for k, dimension, largest, sorted, and output.

methods.name: _avg_pool(name, expand_size)
methods.description: Factory function creating symbolic for average pooling layers with support for 1d, 2d, and 3d variants.

methods.name: _interpolate(name, dim, interpolate_mode)
